item.title: Judge rules against Burt Jones’ unlimited fundraising in race for Georgia governor
item.description: Lt. Gov. Burt Jones can no longer raise millions of dollars for his gubernatorial campaign through a special fundraising committee, a setback in his race for the Republican nomination. The post Judge rules against Burt Jones’ unlimited fundraising in race for Georgia governor appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: New retail development proposed in Grovetown may include a 7 Brew Coffee
item.description: A new retail strip has been proposed for Grovetown’s Lewiston Road/Horizon South corridor, just north of the I-20 exit. The post New retail development proposed in Grovetown may include a 7 Brew Coffee appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Richmond County school board approves facilities master plan affecting six schools
item.description: Richmond County Board of Education approved a facilities master plan Monday night that will close or consolidate multiple schools over the next several years, while board members worked to assure a nervous community that T.W. Josey Comprehensive High School is not being shut down. The post Richmond County school board approves facilities master plan affecting six schools appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta considers bringing in outside help for Finance Department
item.description: Augusta leaders are looking to bring in outside financial support as the city Finance Department faces a period of transition, with the commission expected to consider an outside firm to fill the gaps. The post Augusta considers bringing in outside help for Finance Department appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Illegal deer hunt on Grovetown city property leads to arrests
item.description: Two men have been arrested on multiple hunting and wildlife charges after authorities say they illegally hunted deer on Grovetown-owned property and violated several state regulations. The post Illegal deer hunt on Grovetown city property leads to arrests appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Aiken County coroner confirms identity of victim in fatal crash
item.description: The Aiken County Coroner has identified the man who died Saturday from injuries sustained when he was struck by a vehicle Friday evening. The post Aiken County coroner confirms identity of victim in fatal crash appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta judge gives 2 years to repeat drunk driver who fled after killing bicyclist
item.description: An Augusta man with a long history of traffic offenses has been sentenced to two years in prison, followed by probation, for the 2022 drunken hit-and-run death of a bicyclist on Walton Way. The post Augusta judge gives 2 years to repeat drunk driver who fled after killing bicyclist appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Janell Carwell murder trial under way
item.description: Jury selection continued Tuesday in the murder trial of Leon Lamar Tripp and Tanya Faye Tripp, accused in the 2017 death of 16-year-old LaTania Janell Carwell. The post Janell Carwell murder trial under way appeared first on The Augusta Press.
